It stays near zero on objective property words (red, tall, wooden, rectangular, secure), plain event verbs (made, said, used, given), and exact intensifiers (very, completely, exactly, clearly, certainly); the same evaluative word fires far more weakly as a bare attributive modifier ('the controversial decision', 0.09) than in predicate/appositive position ('the decision was controversial', 1.84), and the peak is the stance word itself rather than the following token, so the unit is retrospective (Jacobian lens kurtosis 3.05, 0% agreement with the logit lens, no coherent promoted token set).
